$comment: What any good explanation of this PR says, written by a model from the PR's title, description and diff only (scripts/eval-assertions.ts). The eval grades each run against them. Delete one that is wrong; keep them stable so evals compare.

assertions.text: Says that admins can configure a Liquid HTML branded layout, wrapping content via content_for_layout, which outbound email inbox replies and transcripts are rendered through.
Says that layout resolution falls back from the inbox-specific layout to the account-level layout, and then to the installation default.
Says that the feature is gated by the account feature flag branded_email_templates, disabled by default, and layout updates are rejected when it is off.
Says that layouts are stored in the existing EmailTemplate table, which gains an inbox_id column so templates can be scoped to an inbox.
Says that the migration replaces the old name/account uniqueness with separate unique indexes for installation, account and inbox scopes.
Says that the layouts are managed only through the API: an admin-only account branded_email_layout endpoint and a branded_email_layout param on inbox update.
Says that the mailer sets Current.inbox and the DB template resolver uses it to pick the inbox layout for email inboxes.
Does not claim that the change adds a dashboard UI for editing layouts or that it applies to non-email channels' inbox-level overrides.
Does not claim that the branded layout is enabled for all accounts by default or that a blank value is stored as an empty layout.
